findings.evidence: Proofs are literally `rw [cgf, mgf_inner_toEuclideanLin_multivariateGaussian_sqrt S hΘ ht]`; the repo's own precedent `TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/ChiSquared.lean:325` delivers `cgf id (chiSquaredMeasure k) t = -(k / 2) * Real.log (1 - 2 * t)`, not `Real.log ((1 - 2 * t) ^ (-(k/2)))`.
findings.fix: State `cgf ... = -1/2 * Real.log ((1 - (2 * t) • ...).det)`, proved by `rw [cgf, mgf_..., Real.log_rpow ht.det_pos]` (`Real.log_rpow` at Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Pow/Real.lean:494, `Matrix.PosDef.det_pos` at Mathlib/Analysis/Matrix/PosDef.lean:85; for the `Θ * S` version the determinant is equal to the sandwich one by `PosSemidef.det_one_sub_smul_sqrt_mul_mul_sqrt`, hence also positive).
findings.issue: `cgf_inner_toEuclideanLin_multivariateGaussian_sqrt` (line 231) and `cgf_inner_toEuclideanLin_multivariateGaussian` (line 251) state the cgf as `Real.log (det ... ^ (-1/2 : ℝ))`. Since `cgf X μ t = log (mgf X μ t)` by definition (Mathlib/Probability/Moments/Basic.lean:125), these add nothing over the mgf lemmas: the log of the rpow is left unevaluated, so every consumer must redo the positivity argument to get a closed form.

Leave the `Matrix.IsHermitian` pencil lemmas unannotated — their right-hand sides mention `hB.eigenvalues`, which is not determined by the left-hand side.
findings.issue: No new declaration in this PR carries `@[simp]`, although the immediately preceding results of the same family do: `integrableExpSet_id_chiSquaredMeasure` (ChiSquared.lean:302), `mgf_id_chiSquaredMeasure` (:310), `cgf_id_chiSquaredMeasure` (:324), `gaussianReal_map_sq` (Gaussian/ChiSquared.lean:50), `covMatrix_multivariateGaussian` (Multivariate.lean:45).

summary: The surface is otherwise minimal and correctly public (no private general infrastructure, no compatibility artifacts, no exposed bodies), but the two cgf lemmas stop at `Real.log (det ^ (-1/2))`, which is just `cgf = log mgf` unfolded, and none of the new characteristic lemmas carries the `@[simp]` annotation its direct precedents in `ChiSquared.lean` carry.
